title: A Cloud 620 Miles Long Rolls Across Australia Every Spring

scenes.text: A cloud 620 miles long rolls across the sky.
It's called the Morning Glory, in northern Australia.
It appears each spring, September to November.
It races along about 40 miles an hour.
Sometimes ten of them roll in, one after another.
Glider pilots ride the wave in front of it.
A cloud you can surf on.

description:
A cloud 620 miles long rolls across the sky.
The Morning Glory cloud can stretch up to 1,000 km across Australia's Gulf Country and moves at 10 to 20 metres per second.
Would you fly a glider next to it?
first_comment: Bonus: it only shows up reliably in one corner of Australia. Have you ever seen a roll cloud?
